goal: Check whether any approved change records cover soc-playground at 2026-07-27T20:19:23Z — resolves whether the authorized_keys write was part of a planned change.
what_to_summarize: active CRs covering soc-playground at the alert timestamp
CR hosts list and whether soc-playground is in scope
absence of any CR if none found

goal: Scan for co-occurring Falco rule fires on soc-playground in a ±15m window around 2026-07-27T20:19:23Z to identify adjacent attack-phase events (cron writes, sensitive file reads, network tools, process spawning) in the same container.
what_to_summarize: all distinct falco.rule names firing on soc-playground in the ±15m window
proc.name and proc.cmdline for each event
any events from the same container as the authorized_keys write
absence of co-occurring events if none found

params.query:
FROM logs-falco.alerts-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-27T20:04:23Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-27T20:34:23Z"
        AND host.name == "soc-playground"
        AND falco.output_fields.container.id == "a36492b5172b"
| STATS events     = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY rule      = falco.rule,
           proc      = falco.output_fields.proc.name,
           cmdline   = falco.output_fields.proc.cmdline,
           parent    = falco.output_fields.proc.pname,
           container = falco.output_fields.container.id
| SORT first_seen ASC

goal: Retrieve the raw Falco event for the authorized_keys modification alert on soc-playground at 2026-07-27T20:19:23Z — need container.name, proc.name, proc.cmdline, user.name, proc.pname, and the target file path.
what_to_summarize: falco.output_fields.target.file or the file path being written
